decisions.reason: As a newly launched map.apps charting bundle with its own page and multiple early releases, it looks like an actively supported add-on that fits the firm's GIS platform business.
The hierarchical search plugin is more niche and less prominently marketed, but it still complements web-map solutions and is likely retained as part of a broader solution portfolio.
Its home-page visibility and clear mobile usability benefit suggest it addresses a relevant customer need and will likely stay on the market.
A platform for building GIS solutions is strategically close to the firm's core business, so an established medium-sized German software firm would usually continue backing it.
Mobile field data capture is a practical enterprise GIS use case, and a dedicated product page indicates enough strategic importance to keep developing it.
A search extension for web map apps is a natural complement to the firm's mapping products, so it is more likely to be kept than withdrawn after such a recent launch.
